name: ethical-research
description: Ethical Research: a research assistant that keeps questioning and checks the record.

plugins.name: ethical-research
plugins.description: Challenges every claim, checks references against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, recomputes reported statistics, scans manuscripts for slop and hidden prompts, and keeps a ledger of open questions that returns every session. Refuses ghostwriting, fabricated citations and AI-use concealment.
